title: Basic Photo Editing
drDigitalIntro:
You can fix a bad photo without being a pro.
• This photo of a bird came out dark and sideways — let's fix both problems.
• Use Rotate to turn it upright.
• Drag the Brightness slider to brighten it up.
• Drag the Contrast slider to make the colors pop.
• Your changes are saved as long as you do not click Revert.

playgroundTask.goal: You fixed a dark, sideways photo

steps.say: Click the Bird in Garden photo — it is dark and sideways.
Click Rotate to turn the bird upright.
The photo is still too dark — drag the Brightness slider above 85.
Now drag the Contrast slider above 85 to make the colors pop.

drDigitalSuccess: One rotate and two sliders turned a dark, sideways shot into a photo worth keeping.
drDigitalHint: Open the Bird in Garden photo, click Rotate once to fix the angle, then drag Brightness and Contrast up.
